Dear Sir / Madam, 
Subject: Audio Recording of Investor/ Analyst Conference Call to discuss the  
Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 
1. 
Further to our communication with respect to the investor/ analyst conference call to 
discuss the Company’s financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, we would like to 
inform that the audio recording of the said conference call, held today, at 03:30 PM, has been 
uploaded to the Company’s website, which can be accessed through the link given below:  
https://cochinshipyard.in/To-Download/CochinShipyardLimitedQ1FY26.mp3  
 
 
2. 
The transcript of the said conference call will be submitted in due course. 
 
3. 
The above is for your information and record please. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
For Cochin Shipyard Limited 
 
 
SEC/48/2017-63 
August 19, 2025 
The Manager 
Compliance Department
